reason: A local music plugin for DeepSeek Harness that searches a configured music folder and provides agent and web-panel controls for playing, pausing, skipping, queuing, and checking playback status.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地音乐搜索、播放、暂停、切歌、排队和播放状态查看功能。
summaries.en: Adds local music search and playback controls to DeepSeek Harness, including play, pause, skip, queue, and status features.

capabilities: Starts and controls local audio playback through afplay or mpv
Provides playback controls through an agent interface and web panel
Queues tracks and reports playback status
